subject: Forecast cleanroom: GreenWave discount approvals blocking Q4 commit
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Volkov <sasha@greenwave.energy>, procurement@greenwave.energy
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast cleanroom: GreenWave discount approvals blocking Q4 commit

Team / Sasha —

Quick summary: GreenWave is asking for a 35% net discount on a 12‑month reserved capacity commitment (expected ACV ~$1.2M) to close before the end of Q4. Deal Desk flagged the price as exceeding our standard concession bands, and we don’t have an approved exec exception yet. Without a near-term response we’ll lose the committed status in the forecast and the opportunity will move to "best case", which materially reduces our Q4 covered commit.

Why this is urgent:
- Close window: GreenWave needs contract countersigned by 9/3 to meet vendor budget cycle.
- Forecast impact: If we drop this to best-case, coverage for Q4 falls by ~$950k.
- Procurement is ready to sign if we can land an approval or interim plan.

Asks:
1) Vanessa — can you escalate to Deal Desk for a priority review and mark this as "forecast-blocking"?
2) Karthik — can Finance provide guidance on whether we can accept a temporary "conditional commit" (we record as commit-probable) while Deal Desk completes policy approval? If yes, what accounting tag should we use?
3) Marissa — attaching the approval request (MA-approval-request-GW-1129.xlsx) and the latest proposal (GreenWave-proposal-v3.pdf). Please reply with the minimal guardrails you require (SLO changes, payment terms, or break clause) to reduce approval time.

Proposed mitigation (if we need to move fast): allow a max 30% approved concession as an interim binding internal approval for forecast reporting, with a written follow-up including final exec signoff by 9/10. If Deal Desk requires a firmer constraint, please state it.

Sasha — we want to keep you on track; if we confirm the interim approach we'll update the contract template with the conditional clause so your procurement can circulate.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555‑0192

Attachments: GreenWave-proposal-v3.pdf, MA-approval-request-GW-1129.xlsx
From: Sasha Volkov <sasha@greenwave.energy>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwave.energy
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast cleanroom: GreenWave discount approvals blocking Q4 commit

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear note. We can hold signature until 9/3 but won’t be able to extend beyond that (internal budget cutoff). A conditional clause is acceptable from our side if it’s documented: GreenWave requires the following to sign today with conditional pricing:
- 30% net discount locked in for 90 days
- Payment: 60 days net after signature
- Clause: final price adjusted down/up after executive approval, with retroactive credit if price increases

If Redwood can issue that and note the provisional nature, procurement will accept and sign. Ideally we'd avoid back-and-forth.

— Sasha
Director, Procurement — GreenWave Energy
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast cleanroom: GreenWave discount approvals blocking Q4 commit

On Sun, Aug 22, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team / Sasha —
> 
> Quick summary: GreenWave is asking for a 35% net discount on a 12‑month reserved capacity commitment (expected ACV ~$1.2M) to close before the end of Q4. Deal Desk flagged the price as exceeding our standard concession bands, and we don’t have an approved exec exception yet. Without a near-term response we’ll lose the committed status in the forecast and the opportunity will move to \"best case\"...

Folks — taking point from Deal Desk. We reviewed the request and 35% is outside our tier‑2 concessions and requires director review plus finance concurrence. That typically takes 3–5 business days.

What would speed this:
- Reducing the requested discount to <=30% (within our expedited concession band)
- Adding a short performance-based clause that allows automatic review after 60 days

If we want a fast path: I can approve an internal interim (Deal Desk provisional) for 30% today if Finance signs off on the accounting treatment and we capture the conditional language in the SOW. Otherwise I’ll route to Director level review which will hit the 9/3 window.

I’ve attached the MA request that lists the concession rationale — it’s missing the SOW clause language and the payment term detail Sasha proposed. If you can confirm the payment term and the 30% floor, I’ll mark as priority and push it through the provisional approval flow.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Analyst | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MA-approval-request-GW-1129.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, Sasha Volkov <sasha@greenwave.energy>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast cleanroom: GreenWave discount approvals blocking Q4 commit

Sofia / team / Sasha —

Finance reviewed the ask and we can accept the proposed interim approach with the following binding conditions: 1) cap concession at 30% for the forecasted commit record; 2) record as "commit-probable" in ACV reporting with HubSpot tag HS-987652; 3) include a 60‑day performance review clause and a payment term of Net 60 as requested by GreenWave.

Operational instructions:
- Sofia: update the HubSpot opportunity with Deal ID GW-2027-Q4-ACV-1129 and set stage to "Commit-Provisional". Add related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-forecast-queues/GW-1129
- Marissa: capture the interim approval in the MA tracker and route for Director sign‑off by 9/10. This will be treated as a conditional commit for Q4 reporting; if Director approval is not obtained by 9/10 we will revert the deal to best case and post a forecast adjustment.
- Vanessa: please confirm with Deal Desk that the provisional approval is entered into the pricing system (internal reference PD-4332) so sales ops can generate the conditional contract template.

Once those items are complete, Finance will accept the deal in the Q4 commit numbers. Great work moving quickly.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
